class: Phone punctuation rejected by explicit numeric placeholder
symptom: MANTECH rejected a ten-digit phone written with punctuation; the same number as ten plain digits passed.
root_cause: The fill path ignored the explicit XXXXXXXXXX placeholder.
fix: Honor an explicit ten-digit placeholder without changing the number; strip a leading US country code only with a United States profile, and leave other lengths/countries unchanged.
why_tests_missed: Phone fixtures did not cover a portal requiring plain digits through its placeholder.
prevention: Check identity-preserving formatting and keep unrelated international numbers unchanged.
